paragraphs: Thank you. This pilot tests a fictional watch store and several menu layouts. We are checking whether the procedures, menus, and measures are usable before a larger study.

Some tasks were designed to be mildly frustrating, confusing, or boring: the search was built to fail and the categories were deliberately ambiguous. Those feelings were part of the procedure, not a judgement of you. The check-ins and neutral resets were there to bring you back to baseline.
We are studying the interface, not the person: the question is whether different menu layouts work better or worse under different everyday moods.

We used webcam-based eye tracking during the scored search trials, with separate consent. No video, images, audio, or automated emotion detection were stored or inferred. Gaze data are kept in a separate restricted dataset and are pseudonymous. You can withdraw your data now or ask the researcher to remove it later.
If you feel unwell or distressed, please tell the researcher. You can stop at any point. Contact details for support should be inserted here after ethics approval.
This is a pilot build. Ethics approval is required before any real participant takes part.
test_mode_notice: Test mode: timers are shortened. Do not use for real participants.
